THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
5 · Cave mouth and approach
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

The trail ends below a wooded hill. A shallow stream runs from a dark cave mouth, with a narrow path beside it. Briars crowd the bank. Cold water murmurs over stone.

The stream and the strip of dry ground offer different approaches to the same black opening. From outside, you can study the banks and the briars before stepping beneath the hill; the sound of running water makes the darkness beyond seem deeper.

Ask the players

“How do you approach? Who scouts the entrance? Are you carrying a light?”

“Where are the wagon and extra supplies?”
